name: Other Projects & Open Source Repositories
tagline: Additional open-source projects, web platforms, and full-stack tools built by Adarsh Patel on GitHub
purpose: Showcases Adarsh's breadth in full-stack development, database tooling, e-commerce, and campus event systems beyond his 7 primary showcase projects.

projects.name: SkillSwap Platform
projects.description: Peer-to-peer skill exchange platform allowing users to trade skills (coding, design, languages) via a request/accept matching mechanism.

projects.name: E-Commerce & Cart System
projects.description: Full-stack e-commerce web platform featuring real-time cart state management, checkout flow, product catalog filtering, and order tracking.

projects.name: CipherSQL Studio
projects.description: Interactive browser-based SQL query sandbox for writing, testing, and visualizing relational database queries with sample schemas.

projects.name: Digital Back Office
projects.description: Enterprise administration portal for internal workflow management, employee task assignment, and document tracking.

projects.name: Student Response & Feedback System
projects.description: Real-time classroom feedback gathering system for automated student responses, instructor polls, and analytics.

projects.name: Mitilence 2K26 Symposium Web Platform
projects.description: Official college technical fest web portal handling event registration, schedule timelines, and team participation.

projects.name: Theekshi Boutique E-Commerce Storefront
projects.description: Custom boutique storefront design featuring product showcases, responsive UI, and interactive shopping gallery.
